item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar already holds the questions that matter: does this moment support the life I'm trying to create, and am I projecting or mind reading? Those only work if you stop and ask them in the moment, not just read them. Notice one point today where a story forms before the facts arrive. Name it as a story, then check it against what you actually know. Action: at midday, pause for one slow breath and answer the first question honestly.
